新发布的 Z-Image Base 模型由 Tongyi-MAI（阿里巴巴人工智能实验室）开发，是 Z-Image 系列的非蒸馏基础，旨在作为开源社区的“原始”起点。 Z-Image Turbo 是针对超快性能和亚秒级推理而优化的精炼版本，仅需 8 个步骤，与此不同的是，Base 模型是一个全权重检查点，需要更多步骤（通常为 28 至 50 个），但在姿势、构图和艺术风格方面提供了显着更高的多样性。虽然 Z-Image Turbo 专门针对即时照片真实感和消费级 GPU 效率进行了调整，但 Z-Image Base 是为需要更灵活的模型来微调、训练 LoRA 或实现复杂的提示遵守的研究人员和创作者而构建的，而更快、更“固执己见”的 Turbo 变体可能会错过这些。与 Z-Image 等其他专业版本相比 Edit 专门针对基于指令的图像到图像任务进行了微调，Base 模型提供了最中性和最不精致的数据分布，对于那些希望将 60 亿参数的 S3-DiT 架构推向速度以外的新的创意领域的人来说，它是最佳选择。

您可以从 CivitAI 下载此工作流程中所需的 Z-Image Base ALL-in-One 模型和 LORA（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何节点，并将正确的文件（AIO 模型、LORA 等）放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的其他工作流程、LORA、工具集、SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、Illustrious、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、lumina 2、Z-Image Base & Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 和 Flux.1 Dev 的数据集。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您想要的 Z-Image Base All-in-One 模型（或将其与 GGUF 模型文件交换）文件即可

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后加载您的蒙版图像以编写输出的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，也可以添加新的 LORA，按顶部的 L 按钮即可在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的风筝按钮。您可以使用 ComfyUI 的遮罩编辑器节点（遮罩效果非常好）或任何您最喜欢的图像编辑器来进行遮罩。但我强烈建议您使用 ComfyUI 的蒙版编辑器节点，因为有时 ComfyUI 无法使用使用外部工具创建的蒙版图像。

This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Seamless Fast Inpainting workflow that will work with the Z-Image Base All-in-One model (with baked in Text Encoder & VAE) that work well with my 8GB AMD GPU or anything similar from Nvidia. But if you have a much weaker GPU (4GB or lower) you can find other low grade hardware supported GGUF models from these HuggingFace Repos -

Unsloth's QWEN3 GGUF Text Encoders for Z-Image Base GGUF models -

------------------------------------------------------------------

https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3-4B-GGUF/tree/main

The newly released Z-Image Base model, developed by Tongyi-MAI (Alibaba's AI lab), is the non-distilled foundation of the Z-Image family, designed to serve as the "raw" starting point for the open-source community. Unlike Z-Image Turbo, which is a distilled version optimized for ultra-fast performance and sub-second inference using as few as 8 steps, the Base model is a full-weight checkpoint that requires more steps (typically 28 to 50) but offers significantly higher diversity in poses, compositions, and artistic styles. While Z-Image Turbo is specifically tuned for immediate photorealism and consumer-grade GPU efficiency, Z-Image Base is built for researchers and creators who need a more flexible model for fine-tuning, training LoRAs, or achieving complex prompt adherence that the faster, more "opinionated" Turbo variant might miss. Compared to other specialized versions like Z-Image Edit, which is fine-tuned specifically for instruction-based image-to-image tasks, the Base model provides the most neutral and unrefined data distribution, making it the superior choice for those looking to push the 6-billion parameter S3-DiT architecture into new, creative territories beyond just speed.

You can download your necessary Z-Image Base ALL-in-One model and LORA used on this workflow from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files (AIO model, LORAs etc) in correct places. Also check out my other workflows, LORAs, toolsets, datasets for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, Illustrious, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, lumina 2, Z-Image Base & Turbo, Flux.2 Klein and Flux.1 Dev. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Z-Image Base All-in-One model (or swap it with GGUF model files) file first and now

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then load your masked image to write your positive and negative prompts for output.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, too add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button. You can use the mask editor node for ComfyUI (masking works very well with it) or any of your favourite image editor for masking. But I would strongly recommend you to use ComfyUI's mask editor node because sometimes ComfyUI fails to use masked image created using external tool.
